title: An OSSIE datasource's ossieYaml model path is confined to the semantic-models directory

criteria.given: an admin POSTing an OSSIE datasource whose ossieYaml names a host file outside the model roots (e.g. /etc/hostname)
criteria.then: the datasource is refused with a typed 400 and is not created — the model path must resolve inside <saiku-home>/semantic-models, the seeded <saiku-home>/data models, or an operator-configured root
GET /rest/saiku/admin/ossie/schema/{datasource} still serves both the TPCDS and Flights models — the confinement admits the seeded <saiku-home>/data root

steps.name: the seeded TPCDS Ossie model still loads
the seeded Flights Ossie model still loads
a datasource whose ossieYaml points outside the model roots is refused with 400
